'''Mogg Wacho''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a union commissioner on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When he began making public expressions of his displeasure with the policies of one of the galactic powers, representatives of that government provided him with motivation to quiet down.<ref name="Mission" />
